context_length: Trained on sequences of up to about 2,048 residues; longer sequences are embedded whole here
summary: The 300M ESM Cambrian encoder; a representation-focused masked PLM that reportedly matches ESM-2 650M at lower cost, producing 960-dim embeddings.
architecture: Encoder-only masked transformer in the ESM-C representation line (parallel to the generative ESM3); 960-dim per-residue embeddings.
pretraining_data: Large-scale natural protein sequence corpora (EvolutionaryScale; see the ESM-C release).
key_innovations: Representation-optimized companion to ESM3, released as open weights
300M reportedly rivals ESM-2 650M with reduced memory and faster inference
when_to_use: A cost-efficient modern encoder: good when you want ESM-2-650M-level quality at smaller size / 960-dim embeddings.
caveats: Primarily documented via the EvolutionaryScale release/blog rather than a peer-reviewed paper; verify exact architecture and training details before citing specifics.
